{{Top|leg}}
The '''Coruscant Mission Tokens''' were given to members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who assisted the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. [[5H-0T]], [[53-A4]] and [[H3-4L]] sold their wares in the [[Training Room (Jedi Temple|Training Room]] of the Jedi Temple, using [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] Mission Tokens as a [[Currency/Legends|currency]].
